summary: MPCA-235 Tournament Wiring Console end-to-end backend verification. 30/30 pytests passing in test_mpca_235_wiring_e2e.py covering matrix shape, wiring-status derivation for all 7 seeded tournaments (bcci/interdiv/district/interschool/interclub/coachingcamp/vacationcamp type_id resolution all correct), Ship 4 visibility filter behaviour, PATCH cell + audit log write-through + wiring-status reflection, freeze-season snapshot revision incrementing + immutability against wiring edits, and MPCA-236 inter-district creation via API.
critical_code_review_comments: tournament_wiring_status._resolve_type_id: the slug-prefix map handles seeded human slugs correctly, but ordering is dict-insertion dependent. Longer prefixes are placed before shorter ones (e.g. 'inter_district' before 'inter_div' would be a bug, but current order 'inter_div' comes before 'inter_district' — verified via test that 'inter_district_men_open' correctly resolves to 'district'. Consider sorting prefixes by length desc for future safety.

PATCH /tournament-wiring/cell mutates the fetched cell in-place before persisting; a concurrent read between $set and audit insert could observe the change without the audit row. Non-blocking but worth a note.
reset_tournament_wiring does not write an audit row — a bulk reset could silently wipe the visibility a user might have configured. Consider inserting a synthetic audit entry.
Ship 4 filter fetches all docs first then filters in Python — acceptable at current scale (<200 tournaments) but should be pushed into the mongo query for scale.
test_credentials: Not required — endpoints accept X-User-Persona: secretary header for Ship 4 filter tests
seed_data_creation: Test creates ephemeral snapshots with cycle=TEST-* and IMMUT-* prefixes (not cleaned up — snapshots are meant to be immutable). Inter-District test tournament is created and deleted within same test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New test file test_mpca_235_wiring_e2e.py adds 30 e2e tests on top of the 18 pre-existing MPCA-235 tests. All 7 seeded tournaments (TRN-2026-27-001..007) resolve to correct wiring type_ids via the _CODE_TO_TYPE slug map. Ship 4 filter correctly hides Championship-scope tournaments from State persona when include_camp_scoped=false. Audit log write-through works. Snapshot revision increments (1,2,3...) per cycle and snapshots are immutable against subsequent PATCH edits.
rca of the issue: No issues found — all functionality per review request verified.
